name: Select
description: Selects one value from a list of options.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: Gets or sets the selected value.

attributes.name: open
attributes.description: Controls whether the options menu is open.

properties.name: options
properties.description: Defines options programmatically when declarative option children are not used. Each option can include label, value, icon, and disabled fields.

events.name: input
events.description: Emitted while the selected value changes.

events.name: change
events.description: Emitted after the selected value changes.

events.name: noora-open-change
events.description: Emitted when the options menu opens or closes.

events.name: noora-select
events.type: CustomEvent<{ item: Record<string, unknown>; value: string }>
events.description: Emitted with the selected option and value.

notes: The component emits standard input and change events.
Use data-icon on a declarative option to show an icon in the menu and selected trigger.

examples.title: Default
examples.description: Select a country from structured options.

examples.title: Selected value
examples.description: Show the current value in the trigger.
examples.markup:
<noora-select label="Country" name="country" value="de">
  <option value="es">Spain</option>
  <option value="de">Germany</option>
  <option value="fr">France</option>
</noora-select>

examples.title: Option icons
examples.description: Add visual context to options and the selected trigger.
examples.markup:
<noora-select label="Workspace" name="workspace" value="application">
  <option value="application" data-icon="category">Application</option>
  <option value="framework" data-icon="category">Framework</option>
  <option value="package" data-icon="category">Package</option>
</noora-select>

examples.title: Hint
examples.description: Explain how the selected value will be used.
examples.markup:
<noora-select label="Country" name="country" hint="Used for regional settings.">
  <option value="es">Spain</option>
  <option value="de">Germany</option>
  <option value="fr">France</option>
</noora-select>

examples.title: Disabled
examples.description: Disable selection when the field is unavailable.
examples.markup:
<noora-select label="Country" name="country" value="de" disabled>
  <option value="es">Spain</option>
  <option value="de">Germany</option>
  <option value="fr">France</option>
</noora-select>
